//: Every upstream DeepSeek mention audit-brand.mjs accepts, with the classification this audit table uses. A = product name (never allowed: it must be replaced with DSH Hub), B = a real model, provider, or service of the official DeepSeek platform, C = an external link or entry point to an upstream site, D = a report that leaves the device for an upstream service. An entry may name `disabledRow`: then the Hub bundle layer must still disable that row, and the check fails once it stops doing so.
